plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 Major Map (recommended sequence) for the B.S. in Statistics, McCausland College of Arts and Sciences, Dept. of Statistics, from the USC Major Map Repository (2026_stat_map.pdf). All 8 semesters transcribed; semester sums verified against printed totals (16/16/15/15/15/15/12/14 at slot minimums = 118 total; official degree minimum 120 per Graduation Requirements Summary: 120 total, 27 major, 47-59 college/program, 34-46 Carolina Core, 2.000 GPA — range slots/electives fill to 120+). Ranged slots transcribed at minimums with notes: Foreign language/other CC (3-4) at 3; Carolina Core Req (3-4) at 3; CSCE 145 (4)/CSCE 106 (3) at 3. STAT Major Electives: 4 courses from STAT 500+, at least one from STAT 513/517/520/535 (CC-INT); foreign language proficiency equivalent to the 122 course; one U.S. + one non-U.S. History required; C or higher (max 2 attempts) in all math/CS/STAT courses required for graduation. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
